scope: Proposition 7.1 (Accuracy of the pasted dynamics) of the manuscript “Hard-sphere fluctuations on the regular Boltzmann lifespan” (preprints/Hard-sphere-fluctuations-on-the-regular-Boltzmann-lifespan-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 364 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e294d8e5097f8d0e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a sufficiently large dimensional integer Γ0 with the following property. Fix Γ ≥ Γ0. There is L0 = L0(Γ, f0, f, T, β) such that, for any fixed L ≥ L0, the true dynamics and the pasted dynamics of Theorem 4.9, coupled using the same initial configuration, satisfy P{the two trajectories differ at some time in [0, T]} ≤ Cϵ1+η (7.1) for all sufficiently small ϵ, where one may take η = 1/20. Here the size cutoffs are the Ai, Λi of Theorem 3.3, and C and the upper bound on ϵ may depend on the displayed fixed parameters.
